sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R. Case No.94 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge, First Track Special Court(POCSO), Bhubaneswar arising out of Nayapalli P.S. Case No.92 of 2024for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376(3)/376-DA/506/34 of IPC read with section 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge, First Track Special Court(POCSO), Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Ad hoc Addl. Sessions Judge(FTSC), Bhubaneswar, by order dated 17.06.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Ad hoc Addl. Sessions Judge(FTSC), Bhubaneswar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner is in custody since 23.02.2024 and as charge sheet has already been filed on 17.04.2024, he may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer.

sentences.text: Perused the 164 Cr.P.C statement of the victim produced by the learned counsel for the Informant.
The same is taken on record.
8. Considering the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application at this stage.

9. Liberty is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer before the learned Court in seisin after the examination of the victim, who shall consider the bail application on its own merit without being influenced by the earlier order passed or the order passed in this bail application.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
